onboarding.fidelity.welcome.title: Your data stays on this device
onboarding.fidelity.welcome.body: Track3 keeps balances, history and settings in a local database. API keys are stored on this device only. Nothing is sent to a Track3 server.
onboarding.fidelity.sources.title: Add a source
onboarding.fidelity.sources.body: Connect an exchange with a read-only API key, add a wallet by address, or link Interactive Brokers with a Flex Query. Add as many as you like.
onboarding.fidelity.history.title: Every refresh is a snapshot
onboarding.fidelity.history.body: History keeps one snapshot per refresh. Open any date, compare two of them, or see what moved between them.
onboarding.fidelity.deeper.title: Planning tools
onboarding.fidelity.deeper.body: Set target allocations and tolerances in Rebalance. Add rules in Goals & alerts for prices, allocation and profit.
onboarding.fidelity.backup.title: Back up your data
onboarding.fidelity.backup.body: Export JSON any time or choose an auto-backup folder. You can also sync between devices through an S3-compatible bucket you own, end-to-end encrypted.
